about: The cities of The Rings of Tristinwold: each with its name, epithet, story, places and the contracts it posts on the shared board. 'at' places each city on the map in metres (x east, z south, so north is negative z). 'seed' grows everything between and beyond them: wilderness, villages, people, quests and endless new cities. 'characters' are the people written by hand, and where they live. Edit freely; restart the server after changes.

cities.name: Tristinwold
cities.story: A walled port of three rings, run from below by the Tongs. The first person each company saves here is Vann. (The main saga: see The Rings of Tristinwold.)

cities.name: Galeholt
cities.story: Horse-lords on an open plain, ruled from the Eyrie. Two clans, the Ashmanes and the Ironsworn, feud over whether to ride to Tristinwold's aid or bar the gates. The Warden-Thane's new court adviser knows too much about the coming war.
places: The Shrine of the Four Winds

contracts.title: Carry a blood-price between the Ashmanes and the Ironsworn before the feud turns to murder
contracts.secret: The new court adviser is paying both clans to keep fighting.

cities.name: Vespergate
cities.story: A widowed queen rules from the Sapphire Court above a sea-arch. Once a year, on Bell Night, the headsman frees one condemned prisoner and nobody knows how he chooses. This year he chose someone who should not exist yet.
places: The Temple of the Seven Lights

contracts.title: Find the prisoner freed on Bell Night before the Crown's agents do
contracts.secret: The prisoner is a Keystone from another company, pulled out of time.

cities.name: Cinderhelm
cities.story: An old, proud city that walls its refugees into the Cinder Quarter. Since the Rift opened the refugees are Ashborn, half-demon children, and someone is killing them one by one while zealots call it holy work.
places: The Temple of the Watchful Sun

contracts.title: Catch whoever is killing Ashborn in the Cinder Quarter
contracts.inDanger: the next Ashborn child marked for death
contracts.secret: The killer believes an angel speaks to him. One does.

cities.name: Argentdeep
cities.story: A stone city cut into a cliff, owned by the Argent family's silver. The silver has started to rot into rust in the miners' hands, and the Argents are blaming the miners.
places: The Temple of the Veiled Lady

contracts.title: Find out why the Argent silver turns to rust
contracts.secret: A fragment of Greed is buried in the deepest seam.

cities.name: Gravenmoor
cities.story: A logging town with more dead than living. Lately the dead aren't staying buried, and the gravekeeper has started bargaining with a voice in the pines.

contracts.title: Put Gravenmoor's restless dead back in their graves
contracts.inDanger: a mourner who went into the pines
contracts.secret: The voice in the pines is a demon lord's herald, early.

cities.name: Mirewatch
cities.story: Stilt houses in a marsh where time runs thin. Children walk into the fog and come back years older, or not at all. The Jarl's seer says it is a crack between eras.

contracts.title: Bring back the children who walked into the fog
contracts.inDanger: a lost girl who came back old
contracts.secret: The fog is one of Vann's cracks: the children are glimpsing the Last Ring.

cities.name: Duskwake
cities.story: A cold harbor where the whole town dreams the same dream every night: a door, and faces they have never met. Nobody sleeps well, and the sleepless are starting to do terrible things.

contracts.title: Find what opens the door in Duskwake's shared dream
contracts.postedBy: The innkeeper of the Sleepless Gull
contracts.secret: It is the Keystones' dream. Duskwake is dreaming it for them.

cities.name: Hollowreach
cities.story: Half the town fell into the sea long ago. What stands is the Temple of the Loom, where the grey-robed Magi guard the device that can send people back in time. They say the town fell when someone used it carelessly.

contracts.title: Escort a grey-robed archivist to the Temple of the Loom
contracts.secret: Something is hunting the Magi, and it already knows the way.

characters.name: Mother Corva
characters.story: The Ravenscrew Tong's barkeep at the Gallows Perch, brought from Argentdeep's forges.

characters.name: Sister Ilse Varrow
characters.story: Head archivist of the Magi's quiet embassy in Tristinwold, brought from the Temple of the Loom.

characters.name: Perrin Velk
characters.story: Galeholt threw him out. Gravenmoor took him in, against its better judgement.
